basic_info.description: * REDUCED! * Panoramic Views! Truly stunning & elegant 2BD, 1.5 bath top-floor flat with sweeping city and Golden Gate views in highly sought-after Russian Hill. Infused with Parisian flair, this elegant residence exudes timeless sophistication with its exquisite architectural details and beautiful French windows that frame the dramatic cityscape. Arched windows & doorways capture the view from all sides. Abundant natural light throughout the day. Elegant living and dining rooms, updated kitchen with marble countertop, gas stove & dishwasher, and remodeled baths with historic stained-glass windows. The breakfast room features custom bench seating, storage drawers, and mesmerizing views of the city and the Golden Gate. Primary BD with city views and oversized walk-in closet with custom shelving. So much character! Perfect blend of old-world charm and modern luxury. 9-unit elevator building. 1 car garage parking + 2 private storage areas. A short distance to the vibrant Polk Street shopping and dining scene in one of SF's most desirable neighborhoods! Current HOA Dues incl. utilities except electricity: $1,809 for 2-person occupancy, $1,637 for single occupancy until HOA reserves are fully funded. Dues expected to be lowered after that.
